dsl.file.encoding: The file is not UTF-8 encoded
dsl.yaml.duplicate_key: Duplicate key {key}; it first appears on line {line}
dsl.yaml.key_not_string: Keys must be strings; quote numbers and true/false when using them as keys
dsl.yaml.recursive: An alias cannot refer to itself
dsl.yaml.too_large: More than {limit} nodes after expanding aliases
dsl.choice.suggest: {value} is not allowed. Did you mean {suggestion}?
dsl.choice.many: {value} is not allowed; run rpa schema to see the allowed values
dsl.schema_version: schemaVersion {value} is not supported; the current version is {current}
dsl.type.string: Must be a string; quote numbers and true/false
dsl.greater_than_equal: Must be greater than or equal to {ge}
dsl.less_than_equal: Must be less than or equal to {le}
dsl.format.slug: {value} has the wrong format: use lowercase letters, digits, - and _, start with a letter or digit, at most 64 characters
dsl.format.identifier: {value} has the wrong format: use letters, digits and _, do not start with a digit, at most 64 characters
dsl.format.secret_name: {value} has the wrong format: use uppercase letters, digits and _, start with a letter, for example ERP_PASSWORD
dsl.format.file_name: {value} has the wrong format: use letters, digits, ., - and _, start with a letter or digit, at most 100 characters
dsl.locator.no_strategy: Specify one way to locate the element: {choices}
dsl.locator.multiple_strategies: Specify only one way to locate the element, found: {fields}; put alternatives in fallback
dsl.locator.name_requires_role: name can only be used with role; {strategy} already matches text
dsl.locator.exact_requires_name: exact only has an effect when role is used with name
dsl.locator.any_frame_with_frame: Put anyFrame on the outermost iframe locator (the innermost frame), not next to frame
dsl.locator.any_frame_in_within: anyFrame cannot be used inside within; put it on the outer locator
dsl.locator.nested_fallback: A fallback locator cannot have its own fallback
dsl.page.undefined: Tab {name} is not open yet: an earlier step needs popup: {name} to open it
dsl.popup.duplicate: Tab name {name} is already used by the tab opened in step {first}
dsl.one_of.many: Specify only one of these fields, found: {fields}
dsl.url.invalid: {value} is not a valid URL: start with http:// or https://, or start with / and set browser.baseUrl
dsl.url.invalid_base: {value} is not a valid URL: start with http:// or https://
dsl.url.relative_without_base: {value} is a relative path; set the site URL in browser.baseUrl first
dsl.expect.page_check_with_target: {field} checks the whole page and cannot be used with target
dsl.expect.match_not_applicable: match only applies to text, value, url and title, not to {field}
dsl.extract.attribute_required: When get is attribute, name the attribute with attribute, for example href
dsl.extract.fields_with_get: With fields, each field sets its own get
dsl.extract.table_conflict: {field} cannot be used when get is table
dsl.screenshot.full_page_with_target: fullPage cannot be used with target (element screenshot)
dsl.step.duplicate_id: Step id {id} is already used by step {first}
dsl.template.undeclared_secrets: Uses the undeclared secret {name}; add it to secrets
dsl.value.range: The upper limit cannot be less than the lower limit
dsl.value.default_invalid: The default value does not satisfy {rule}
dsl.verify.constant_value: value must use {{{{ }}}} to refer to what is checked, for example {{{{ facts.name }}}}
dsl.verify.required_for_outputs: Scenarios with outputs need verify: outputs are published only after the independent assertions pass
dsl.output.from_required: Output {name} needs from to say where its value comes from, for example {{{{ facts.name }}}}
dsl.format.script_path: {value} is not a valid script path: use a relative path inside the scenario folder ending in .py, without ..
dsl.format.timestamp: {value} is not a time with a UTC offset, e.g. 2026-10-19T06:40:00-07:00
dsl.format.digest: {value} is not a sha256 hash (64 lowercase hexadecimal characters)
dsl.script.verify_not_allowed: Python script scenarios are asserted by assertion.py; leave out verify
dsl.script.output_from_not_allowed: Outputs of Python script scenarios come from assertion.py; leave out from
dsl.script.missing: Script {value} not found (relative to the scenario file's folder)
dsl.extract.duplicate_as: facts.{name} is already produced by step {first}
dsl.template.undeclared_inputs: Uses the undeclared input {name}; add it to inputs
dsl.template.unknown_fact: No extract produces facts.{name}; extract it in a step with as: {name}
dsl.template.fact_not_yet: facts.{name} is only produced by a later extract step
dsl.template.facts_unavailable: No page facts exist yet here, so facts cannot be used
recording.header: Draft converted from a recording ({time}). Validate before publishing; input names and defaults can be changed on the scene page.
recording.header_warnings: {count} line(s) could not be converted and are kept as comments among the steps (search for "Recording line").
recording.syntax: The recording is not valid Python (line {line})
recording.empty: The recording has no actions that can be converted and no start URL
recording.invalid: The converted scenario did not pass validation: {detail}
recording.loose_filter: "{text}" originally had to match the whole text; it now only has to contain it. Check during debugging that a single element is found
recording.dropped_position: The click position was dropped; the element is clicked in its center
recording.frame_click: This clicks the iframe element itself ({target}); when run it clicks the middle of the iframe, not a particular field or button inside it. Check whether the step is needed
recording.typed_as_fill: {name} types one key at a time; it becomes fill (the whole text at once), so per-key events are not fired. If the field reacts to key presses (for example search as you type), check it when debugging
recording.unsupported.arguments: The arguments of {name} are not fixed text or a list
recording.unsupported.options: Options {options} of {name} are not supported yet
recording.unsupported.popup: This opens a new tab, but the step that opens it could not be converted, so actions on that tab are skipped too
recording.unsupported.other_page: Tab {page} was not opened by a recorded action (for example a tab you opened yourself), so actions on it are not supported yet
recording.unsupported.upload: File uploads are not supported yet (M7)
dsl.workflow.value_null: A fixed value cannot be null; to use the scenario's default, leave this input out
dsl.workflow.empty: The composite scenario has no nodes yet
dsl.workflow.input_unknown: Node {node}: the scenario has no input {input}
dsl.workflow.input_missing: Node {node}: input {input} has no default; give it a fixed value or an output of an earlier node
dsl.workflow.value_invalid: Node {node}: the fixed value of input {input} does not satisfy {rule}
dsl.workflow.source_unknown: Node {node}: input {input} comes from node {source}, which does not exist
dsl.workflow.source_order: Node {node}: input {input} can only use outputs of earlier nodes, and {source} is not before it
dsl.workflow.output_unknown: Node {node}: input {input} comes from output {output} of {source}, but that scenario revision has no such output
dsl.workflow.type_mismatch: Node {node}: input {input} ({input_type}) comes from output {output} of {source} ({output_type}); the types do not match
dsl.workflow.source_not_passed: Node {node}: input {input} comes from {source}, which did not pass
dsl.workflow.output_missing: Node {node}: {source} passed but did not publish output {output}
dsl.workflow.mode_version: Version 1 requires serial; version 2 requires dag. Serial definitions cannot contain edges.
dsl.workflow.cycle: Dependencies contain a cycle. Remove the conflicting edge or output binding.
dsl.workflow.source_ambiguous: Node {node}: input {input} matches multiple upstream outputs; choose a source
dsl.workflow.auto_requires_dag: Node {node}: automatic binding for {input} requires a version 2 DAG
dsl.workflow.auto_unresolved: Node {node}: automatic source for input {input} has not been resolved
pack.no_manifest: pack.yaml (the domain manifest) is missing; this folder cannot be loaded
pack.spec_version: Folder format specVersion: {value} is not supported; this version of RPA only understands {current}. Please update RPA
pack.id_mismatch: The id in pack.yaml is {id}; it should be {expected}
pack.bad_name: {name} does not follow the id rules (lowercase letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter or digit); skipped
pack.scene_no_manifest: Scene {scene} has no scene.yaml; skipping this scene
pack.scene_id_mismatch: The id in scene.yaml is {id}; it must match the folder name {expected}. Skipping this scene
pack.scene_no_revisions: Scene {scene} has no revisions; skipping this scene
pack.revision_bad_name: {name} in revisions/ is not a revision number; skipped
pack.revision_orphan_info: Revision file {file} has no matching revision folder; skipped
pack.revision_no_info: Revision {number} has no revision file {file}; it cannot be run or published
pack.revision_number_mismatch: The revision file says number {value}; it should be {number}. This revision cannot be run or published
pack.revision_invalid: The scenario of revision {number} failed validation ({count} issue(s)); it cannot be run or published
pack.revision_scene_id: The scenario id of revision {number} is {id}; it should be {scene}. This revision cannot be run or published
pack.revision_extra_file: Revision {number} contains a file the scenario does not use: {file}
pack.revision_hash_mismatch: The content of revision {number} does not match the hash in its revision file (an existing revision was modified); it cannot be run or published
pack.verification_bad_folder: {name} in verifications/ is not a revision number; skipped
pack.verification_no_revision: There are validation records for revision {number}, but no such revision; skipped
pack.verification_revision: The validation record says revision {value} but is in the folder of revision {number}; skipped
pack.published_no_revision: Revision {number} is marked as published, but it does not exist; not treated as published
pack.published_changed: The published revision {number} was modified and no longer matches its revision file's hash; not treated as published. Save a new revision, validate it, then publish
pack.published_unusable: The published revision {number} has problems (see the other issues for this scene); not treated as published
pack.published_unverified: The published revision {number} has no passed validation record with a matching hash; not treated as published. Validate it, then publish again
pack.published_proof_missing: The validation record {id} that the publication refers to is missing or did not pass, but revision {number} has another passed validation record
pack.role_id_mismatch: The role id is {id}; it must match the file name {expected}. Skipping this role
pack.role_url_invalid: {field} must be a full http(s) URL: {value}
pack.role_check_invalid: check (the element visible when logged in) is not a valid locator: {detail}
pack.role_steps_not_list: must be a list of steps
pack.sensitive_file: {file} looks like a login state, Secrets or a private key and must not be in a domain folder; please remove it
pack.composite_no_manifest: Composite scenario {composite} has no composite.yaml; skipping it
pack.composite_id_mismatch: The id in composite.yaml is {id}; it must match the folder name {expected}. Skipping this composite scenario
pack.composite_no_revisions: Composite scenario {composite} has no revisions; skipping it
pack.composite_unreadable: workflow.json of revision {number} is not valid JSON: {detail}; this revision cannot be run or published
pack.composite_requires_mismatch: The requires list in the file of revision {number} does not match the nodes of its definition; this revision cannot be run or published
pack.requires_not_declared: Composite scenario {composite} uses scenarios from domain {domain}, but requires in pack.yaml does not list it
pack.requires_domain: The required domain {domain} is not loaded (needs {scene} revision {revision})
pack.requires_scene: Domain {domain} has no scenario {scene} (revision {revision} is needed)
pack.requires_revision: Scenario {scene} in domain {domain} has no revision {revision}
pack.requires_unusable: Revision {revision} of scenario {scene} in domain {domain} has problems and cannot run
pack.requires_hash: Revision {revision} of scenario {scene} in domain {domain} differs from when the composite scenario was saved
pack.requires_not_checked: The required domain {domain} was not checked; add its folder to the command to check the dependencies
pack.composite_unpinned: A node of revision {number} uses {scene} revision {revision}, which could not be found when it was saved, so it is not in requires; save again after adding the scenario to run it
dsl.dynamic.empty: Nothing inside {{{{ }}}}; dynamic values can be today, now or random
dsl.dynamic.date_syntax: Cannot read {text}; write dates as today, today+1 or today-1, with an optional format after a colon, e.g. today:YYYY/MM/DD
dsl.dynamic.offset_range: The number of days in {text} exceeds {limit}
dsl.dynamic.format_no_token: The format in {text} has no date or time fields; use YYYY, MM, DD, HH, mm, ss
dsl.dynamic.format_time: {text}: today has no time of day; the month is upper-case MM (lower-case mm is minutes); use now for times
dsl.dynamic.random_syntax: Cannot read {text}; write random integers as random:min:max, e.g. random:10:30
dsl.dynamic.random_range: In {text} the minimum {low} is greater than the maximum {high}
dsl.template.dynamic_in_step: {name} is a dynamic value for input values and cannot be used in a step directly; add an input whose default is {{{{{name}}}}} and refer to it with {{{{ inputs.NAME }}}}
dsl.workflow.value_dynamic: Node {node}: the fixed value of input {input}: {detail}
dsl.yaml.unquoted_template: Values that start with {{{{ need quotes, e.g. "{{{{today}}}}" or "{{{{ inputs.title }}}}"
dsl.dynamic.number_range: The number in {text} is too long to convert; use fewer digits
